Folio 1r - 2v: The Genesis of the Convergence

### Folio 1r: The Cross and the Crescent

\[ORIGINAL ROHONC SCRIPT - RIGHT TO LEFT\]  
𐌀𐌁𐌂 ⰄⰅⰆ ⍙⍒⍋ ⱇⱈⱉ 𐌗𐌘𐌙 ⍝⍜⍡ ⱚⱛⱜ  
ⰢⰣⰤ 𐌗𐌘𐌙 ⍙⍒⍋ ⱇⱈⱉ 𐌀𐌁𐌂 ⍝⍜⍡ ⱚⱛⱜ  

**\[ENGLISH TRANSLATION\]**

In the beginning of the great convergence, the wooden cross of the new god was placed upon the silver crescent of the old night. The priests of the cross built their stone temples over our sacred groves, but they did not understand the geometry of the earth. We write these words in the hidden tongue so that the true architecture of the world is not forgotten by the children of the sun.

\[ORIGINAL ROHONC SCRIPT - RIGHT TO LEFT\]

### Folio 45r: The Four Elements and the Fifth Anchor

\[ORIGINAL ROHONC SCRIPT - RIGHT TO LEFT\]  
⍝⍜⍡ ⱇⱈⱉ 𐌀𐌁𐌂 ⰄⰅⰆ ⍙⍒⍋ ⱚⱛⱜ 𐌗𐌘𐌙

**\[ENGLISH TRANSLATION\]**

But the fifth element, the invisible ether, is the canvas upon which reality is drawn. The holy trinity of the church is incomplete without the dual-nature of the pagan gods. To master reality, you must weld the three to the two, creating the perfect five.
